verdict.rationale: Glama's llms.txt says every listed server is 'scanned, scored', and community users describe an automated quality-score test (TDQS) that runs against new server versions. Neither source says the scanning targets malicious or vulnerable behavior rather than general quality. The browser inspector and gateway access controls are manual testing and runtime governance, not pre-use vetting. Missing for 10: documentation of what the scan checks (malware, vulnerabilities, suspicious tool behavior), security findings surfaced on server pages, and independent corroboration that security scanning happens before agents use a server.
